blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) is urging licensed firearm holders across the country to make responsible gun handling and secure storage a constant practice to prevent unauthorized access and help protect families and communities. The PNP Civil Security Group (CSG) has rolled out the nationwide “Gun Safety Advocacy Campaign” amid recent firearm-related incidents involving minors in school settings that have renewed concerns over access to legally owned firearms.
